definitions.gloss: arts and crafts; art and handicrafts
definitions.explanation: A subject taught in Japanese elementary schools covering drawing, painting, sculpting, and making crafts. Short for {図画工作|ずがこうさく} (drawing and handicrafts).

examples.japanese: {図工|ずこう}の{時間|じかん}が{好|す}きだった。
examples.english: I liked arts and crafts class.

examples.japanese: {図工|ずこう}で{粘土|ねんど}の{作品|さくひん}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: We made clay works in arts and crafts class.

examples.japanese: {小学校|しょうがっこう}の{図工|ずこう}の{授業|じゅぎょう}で{水彩画|すいさいが}を{描|えが}いた{思|おも}い{出|で}がある。
examples.english: I have memories of painting watercolors in elementary school art class.

notes:
Abbreviation of {図画工作|ずがこうさく}. Taught in Japanese elementary schools (grades 1–6), covering a broad range of creative activities including drawing, painting, clay work, woodworking, and paper crafts. In junior high school, the subject name changes to {美術|びじゅつ} (fine arts) and {技術|ぎじゅつ} (technology/crafts).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {図工|ずこう}の{時間|じかん}: arts and crafts period/class
- {図工|ずこう}の{授業|じゅぎょう}: arts and crafts lesson
- {図工|ずこう}の{作品|さくひん}: artwork from arts and crafts

RELATED WORDS:
- {図画工作|ずがこうさく}: drawing and handicrafts — the full, formal name
- {美術|びじゅつ}: fine arts — the equivalent subject in junior high and high school
- {工作|こうさく}: handicrafts, crafting — the making/building component
